schema: CREATE TABLE customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT)
CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount INTEGER, status TEXT)
sql_cases.reference: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status='done' GROUP BY c.region HAVING SUM(o.amount)>150 ORDER BY c.region

schema: CREATE TABLE departments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE employees(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, dept_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER)
sql_cases.reference: WITH ranked AS (SELECT d.name dept,e.name,e.salary,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY d.id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) r FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.id=e.dept_id) SELECT dept,name,salary FROM ranked WHERE r=2 ORDER BY dept,name

schema: CREATE TABLE events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER, event_type TEXT, happened_at TEXT)
sql_cases.reference: SELECT substr(happened_at,1,7) month, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) active_users FROM events WHERE event_type='login' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

schema: CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sales(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER, quantity INTEGER, unit_price INTEGER)
sql_cases.reference: WITH rev AS (SELECT p.category,p.name,SUM(s.quantity*s.unit_price) revenue FROM products p JOIN sales s ON s.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC,name ASC) rn FROM rev) SELECT category,name,revenue,rn FROM ranked WHERE rn<=2 ORDER BY category,rn

schema: CREATE TABLE tickets(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, priority TEXT, opened_at TEXT, sla_hours INTEGER, status TEXT)
sql_cases.reference: SELECT priority,COUNT(*) breach_count FROM tickets WHERE status='open' AND datetime(opened_at,'+'||sla_hours||' hours') < datetime('2026-09-24 00:00:00') GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority

schema: CREATE TABLE subscriptions(user_id INTEGER, signup_date TEXT, churn_date TEXT)
sql_cases.reference: SELECT user_id FROM subscriptions WHERE churn_date IS NOT NULL AND julianday(churn_date)-julianday(signup_date)<=30 ORDER BY user_id

schema: CREATE TABLE payments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account TEXT, amount INTEGER, status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE refunds(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payment_id INTEGER, amount INTEGER, status TEXT)
sql_cases.reference: WITH r AS (SELECT payment_id,SUM(amount) refund FROM refunds WHERE status='done' GROUP BY payment_id) SELECT p.account,SUM(p.amount-COALESCE(r.refund,0)) net_revenue FROM payments p LEFT JOIN r ON r.payment_id=p.id WHERE p.status='success' GROUP BY p.account ORDER BY p.account

schema: CREATE TABLE projects(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE tasks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, project_id INTEGER, status TEXT)
sql_cases.reference: SELECT p.name FROM projects p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.project_id=p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.project_id=p.id AND t.status<>'done') ORDER BY p.name
